name: Instant Race
author: Moorzii
description: Skip the menus: pick (or randomise) an era, car, track and weather from your installed packs and jump straight into a race. Includes a Surprise mode. Press F7 on the main menu. Beta: restart the game between Instant Races.

options.label: Instant Race Menu Key
options.description: Keyboard key used on the main menu to open or close Instant Race.

options.label: Show Instant Race Button
options.description: Show the Instant Race button in the top right of the main menu.
